analysis.name: qwen3tts-voicedesign
analysis.whisper_small_en: Goal, Ava! It's football day! Tiffin has boots. Tiffin has a ball. Where is Ava's shirt? Here it is. Peep. Kick off. Pass, pass, pass. Tiffin to Ava. Thud. One more pass to Ava. Ready? Steady? Goal. Goal, Ava. Goal, goal, goal. Home we go. Boots off. Lights low. Paw in hand, side by side. What a big day, Neve. Night, night, Tiffin. Night, night, Neve.

render.instruct_A: A gentle, warm British woman in her early thirties with a soft Southern English accent, reading a bedtime picture book to a toddler: calm, kind, smiling, unhurried, with natural pauses and soft endings to phrases. She sounds quietly delighted and playful for the football game, but never loud or shouty; her excitement is soft and smiling.
render.instruct_B: A gentle, warm British woman in her early thirties with a soft Southern English accent, reading a bedtime picture book to a toddler: calm, kind, smiling, unhurried, with natural pauses and soft endings to phrases. Now she is winding down for sleep: much slower and softer, hushed and sleepy, almost whispering, with long gentle pauses.
text_A: Tiffin has boots. Tiffin has a ball. Where is Ava's shirt? Here it is!
Peep! Kick-off! Pass, pass, pass! Tiffin to Ava... thud!
One more pass... to Ava! Ready... steady... Goal! Goal, Ava! Goal, goal, goal!
text_B: Home we go. Boots off. Lights low.
Paw in hand, side by side. What a big day, Neeve.
Night night, Tiffin. Night night, Neeve.
